name: Protein French Toast with Peanut Butter & Homemade Jam
steps: Tip the berries into a saucepan set over a medium heat. Cook for 5-7 mins until juicy, then stir in the lemon juice and mash to your desired jam consistency. Add the chia seeds and honey, cook for a few minutes until thickened, then set aside to cool.
Combine the milk and protein powder in a shallow dish to form a paste. Add the egg and egg whites, then whisk together with the protein paste until smooth.
Heat a non-stick frying pan and soak both sides of each slice of bread in the egg mixture. Once the pan is hot, add the soaked bread to the pan. Cook over a medium heat for a few minutes each side.
Load the slices of toast onto a plate, then add the yoghurt, peanut butter and jam. Drizzle with the honey and the extra peanut butter, then scatter the crushed peanuts on top.
